verification_notes: Read v1 complete methodology, training and experiments pages1–10; Figures3/4 and Tables1–3 rendered and visually inspected.
Alpaca7B, ResNet50/InternImageH, BERTBase and pretrained DeformableDETR distinguished; 60.2 AP requires H visual backbone.
Parallel output-format queries distinguished from ordinary autoregressive caption decoding; no FPS speed-up invented.
Coordinates are discrete offsets relative to image-token location; range512 gives1025 signed bins, classification mapping is prompt-dependent rather than fixed COCO token semantics.
Instance segmentation polygon limits and lower AP75 preserved; pose is possible formulation, not quantitatively evaluated in paper.
VQA qualitative-only, caption COCO Karpathy and RefCOCO validation protocols retained; each-task separate models not conflated with shared model.
Table2 restricted class AP not claimed comparable with all80-class AP; 50epochs default not asserted as each-stage schedule; LoRA rank and exact task ratios not invented.
